name: 멀티 카메라 9 그리드
description: 같은 참고 이미지로 구성한 3×3 시네마틱 카메라 시트
prompt:
Analyze the entire input image and identify all key subjects, their appearance,
clothing, objects, environment, spatial relationships, lighting, and overall mood.

Using the uploaded image as the strict visual reference, create ONE single image
containing a clean 3x3 cinematic contact sheet with exactly 9 panels.

The same subject(s), identity, face, hairstyle, clothing, props, environment,
lighting direction, time of day, and overall visual style must remain consistent
across all 9 panels.

Only change the camera position, camera angle, framing, distance, and focal length.

ROW 1 — Establishing shots
1. Extreme Long Shot — subject small within the full environment
2. Long Shot — full body / full object visible
3. Medium Long Shot — knees-up for a person, 3/4 view for an object

ROW 2 — Main coverage
4. Medium Shot — waist-up
5. Medium Close-Up — chest-up
6. Close-Up — tight face / main object detail

ROW 3 — Detail and camera angles
7. Extreme Close-Up — eyes, hands, texture, logo, or defining detail
8. Low Angle Shot — camera near ground looking upward
9. High Angle Shot — camera above looking downward

Maintain strict visual continuity in every panel.
Do not redesign the subject.
Do not change clothing, hairstyle, age, facial identity, environment, or lighting.
Do not add new people or objects unless they already exist in the reference image.

Use realistic perspective and lens behavior.
Wide shots should have deeper depth of field;
close-ups should have natural shallow depth of field and bokeh.

Output:
one professional 3x3 cinematic storyboard/contact sheet,
exactly nine frames, evenly divided, photorealistic,
consistent cinematic color grading.
